description:
Wood burning on a open fireplace. Recorded inside a large wooden goahti at Ylläskaltio hotel in Äkäslompolo, Finland.

Recorded with Roland R-26 at 44k 24-bit using XY mic pair. 48dB/oct hipass filter @ 30Hz and some limiting applied.

If you use the sound on a project of yours, please leave a comment. A link to your project is also much appreciated so I can check it out! :)

.. and don't forget to check out other sounds in the Goahti Session!
name: Campfire.wav
